domain: A long-running dispute among orchestral archivists over whether a composer's deleted bars should ever be restored in performance editions, and what the argument is really about
topic: A long-running dispute among orchestral archivists over whether a composer's deleted bars should ever be restored in performance editions, and what the argument is really about

movement.gist: Introduce the archivists' feud over a specific case: a symphony's slow movement where the composer crossed out sixteen bars before publication. One camp insists the deletion is final and binding; the other wants the bars restored because early audiences apparently heard them. Define 'the work' early, in passing, as 'what the composer authorized' — this innocuous-looking definition is the thesis, though it reads as mere throat-clearing.

Show the dispute escalating beyond this one symphony: societies split, editions multiply, funding bodies take sides, a scholarly journal runs a special issue. The stakes are described as though they were about scholarly rigor and audience experience, but the escalation is disproportionate to sixteen bars of music.

Anatomize the proxy: the fight over the deleted bars is really a fight over whether artistic meaning is fixed at the moment of creation or accrues through reception. Restorationists are covert believers in the work-as-communal-inheritance; strict-editionists are covert believers in the artist as sole sovereign over meaning. The textual quarrel is where these unstateable commitments can be fought using footnotes instead of manifestos.

Explain why the deeper question about authorship and meaning cannot be argued directly: it has no shared evidentiary standard, invokes incompatible pictures of what art is for, and any direct debate collapses into assertion. The proxy dispute survives because it offers falsifiable-looking sub-questions (what did the composer cross out, when, why) that stand in for the unfalsifiable one.

poles: the composer's final intention as the sole legitimate authority
the work as a living object whose meaning exceeds any single authorial act

tension_system.interaction: the evidence dispute looks like the real fight over method, but it only exists because the deeper question of authority has been smuggled into the definition of 'the work' before any evidence is examined

family_realization.note: The Proxy War executes flawlessly. Para 3 explicitly diagnoses: 'the proxy is not merely convenient. It is the only venue.' The brown ink dispute anatomizes a deeper, unstatable disagreement about artistic ownership. Surface never adjudicated; readers expecting verdict find instead an explanation of *why* adjudication fails—the intended structural payoff.

ending_behavior.note: The Horizon Clause is present but slightly soft. 'They will remain right until someone can say, in plain terms and to a standard both camps accept, what a work is' conditions obsolescence on a specific change. The closure qualifies resolution but doesn't quite 'hold' with maximum aperture—it leans slightly toward resolution-by-future-definition rather than permanent irresolution.

voice_consistency.note: Institutional Anthropologist voice sustained throughout. 'Call them the strict editionists'—familiar naming. 'Meaning silts up over generations.' The broken window sash, the drunk Leipzig reviewer, the card index no one migrated—concrete particulars embedded in abstract reasoning. No generic AI-essay homogeneity; rhythm is uneven and intentional.

distractor_efficiency.note: Every question has genuine traps. Q1(B): framework_import—plausible sociological reading of escalation. Q2(A): half_truth—settles one sub-question, trapping readers who conflate proxy-resolution with deep-question resolution. Q3(A): prior_belief—the restorationists' sympathetic framing makes this seductive. Q6(A): pitch_perfect—exactly restorationist language, testing whether readers tracked the author's verdict-granting.

explanation_quality.note: Wrong-option explanations anchor to passage mechanisms. Q1(B) correctly names 'para 3 locates escalation in unstated beliefs, not institutional reward.' Q2(A) identifies it as 'half_truth' with reasoning tied to para 4's claim. Q3(D) names the category error ('history of term vs. transfer of procedure'). No 'not mentioned' padding; every rejection is mechanistic.
